# Security Policy

## Supported Version

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| Latest  | Yes |
| Older   | No |


## Reporting Security Issue

Jika menemukan masalah keamanan:

- Jangan membuat issue publik.
- Laporkan secara privat melalui repository owner.


## Automatic Protection

Project menggunakan:

- GitHub Actions
- Dependabot
- npm audit
- Vercel deployment protection
